description: Window control: dragging the title bar, minimising and closing. On Windows and Linux the window is created undecorated, so the app's own caption buttons are the only ones the user has — see buildChrome in apps/web/lib/app.js. A phone has no window to drive, so this capability is not granted there. Self-update lives in update.json instead, because it is granted on a NARROWER set than this: macOS updates through its Homebrew cask.
